A few useful answers.

Is this reading my clipboard?

No. The preview only writes the text you choose to copy. It never reads your clipboard.

Will my edits be saved?

Your edits remain while you switch categories, but reset when the page reloads. No content is sent to a server.

Can I adapt this into a real product?

Yes. The navigation, category tabs, editable preview and motion are plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The README describes the local demo boundary.
